mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_CHARGE_DATA ( CONTRACT_NUMBER, HOTBILL_DATE, CHARGE_CODE, AMOUNT, ERROR_CODE, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATE_DATETIME ) VALUES ( #{contractNumber}, #{hotbillDate}, #{chargeCode}, #{amount}, #{errorCode}, #{errorMessage}, #{createDatetime} )
mapper.select: SELECT CONTRACT_NUMBER, HOTBILL_DATE, CHARGE_CODE, AMOUNT, ERROR_CODE, ERROR_MESSAGE, CREATE_DATETIME FROM TB_CHARGE_DATA WHERE CONTRACT_NUMBER = #{contractNumber} AND HOTBILL_DATE = #{hotbillDate} ORDER BY CHARGE_CODE
